pg-1.text: Northwind Studio and Lisbon Harbour Hotel · 28 October 2026

pg-3.text: Northwind Studio photographs the hotel's terrace, rooms and harbour view over two days and delivers 60 edited photos and a 90-second film.

pg-5.text: Edited photos within 14 days of the shoot, as full-size JPEG and web-size copies, shared through a Beebeeb link that expires after 30 days.

pg-7.text: A fixed fee of €6,400, half on signing and half on delivery. Travel within Lisbon is included.

pg-9.text: The hotel may use the photos on its own website, social channels and printed materials for five years.
